description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendments to the Gaz. Ex,. NOo. 1714/9, Moratuwa D/S Division and other amendments
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration amendments under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains multiple entries detailing specific amendments to land parcel titles, including changes to village names and servitude rights for various land parcels in different blocks and cadastral maps. The content is purely land and property-related, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, title amendments, and property boundary/description changes without any government personnel changes or structural administrative matters.
